entries.text: There you are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_01

entries.text: I had a feeling you’d turn up if I hung out here\nfor a while...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_02

entries.text: And lo and behold, I was right![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_03

entries.text: Well, now that I’ve found you, we should swing\nby my room and have a chat![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_04

entries.text: Ta-ta-tachán! Welcome to the Zona Nemona![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_05

entries.text: It’s so tidy!
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_01

entries.text: It’s very you!
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_02

entries.text: Aw, thank— Wait a sec... I know we’ve been to\nYOUR room before...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_06

entries.text: But have I never had you over here? Wild![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Anyway, uh... Listen, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
You
know
how
I, well...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_08

entries.text: You know how I really like Pokémon battles?\nLike, really, REALLY like ’em?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_09

entries.text: Yeah, you sure do
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_03

entries.text: I noticed
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_04

entries.text: Cool. And yeah, you know how when you really\nlike something, you dive in deep?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_10

entries.text: That’s what I did with Pokémon battles, and I...\njust kinda became a Champion?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_11

entries.text: But then I found out that’s pretty special—that\nnormally, it’s not so simple for most people.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_12

entries.text: People would tell me to my face that I’d only\nmanaged it ’cause I have some innate gift, or\r\n’cause I was raised differently, or whatever.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_13

entries.text: And suddenly I started to feel like there was this\ninvisible wall between me and everyone else.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_14

entries.text: So I started going easy when I’d battle my\nfriends. I just wanted everyone to have fun.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_15

entries.text: Oh, but don’t worry, I’m not doing that anymore!\nI’m going 100-percent all out![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_16

entries.text: Especially since I’m lucky enough to have an\nopponent around who can beat me even when\r\nI’m in full hard-core mode![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_17

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So just promise me one thing,\nOK, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_18

entries.text: Promise you’ll always stay my equal! You and me,\ntrue rivals![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_19

entries.text: You know it!
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_05

entries.text: That’s what friends are for!
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_system_06

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Heh heh. You’re the best,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\r\nThank you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_20

entries.text: Oof, that got pretty personal! Little bit\nembarrassed over here...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_21

entries.text: Anyway! Since we’re equals, I gotta start having\nyou over as much as we hang out in your room![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_22

entries.text: Feel free to burst on into the Zona Nemona\nwhenever you want![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_23

entries.text: And get ready for the Academy Ace Tournament,\n’cause I’m gonna stomp ya this time![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: kizuna_rival_d_24
